sources.label: PMID 38894576: Growth hormone treatment for neurologic symptoms of post-acute sequelae of COVID
NCT03554265: Brain and Gut Plasticity in Mild TBI or Post-acute COVID Syndrome Following Grow

limitations: n=13 open-label; selection requires documented low GH response; symptoms rebound on cessation; no placebo control for symptom outcomes; GH costs/risks (edema, glucose, IGF-1 monitoring). NCT03554265 mixes mTBI and PASC. Not medical advice. Tracker Moderate label is not an OSMF A/B grade.
